# NO FUN OS

> No Fun OS is a local-first agentic development environment built on Warp, made by Jimmy Simmons of No Fun Studio. Claude is the controlling interface; coding agents, tools, and subscriptions become workers behind it. Text stays primary. Rich interfaces appear only when information deserves pixels.

A terminal and Notion fucked. Then a magical side quest lets your agents render anything in your own design language.

## Made by

- [Jimmy Simmons — No Fun Studio](https://nofun.io): the studio behind No Fun OS
